nodes.label: docs/canon/CANON_AUDIT.md — what the repo tells agents vs. what the user actually said. 117 prescriptive repo claims adjudicated against the record across seven surfaces. Its verdicts are not rulings, and it does not sit above the material it adjudicates

The question asked: where does this repo's canon state something the user never said, and where does it contradict something he did say? Ground truth used, and nothing else counts as the user's voice: docs/canon/raw/user_turns_all.jsonl / .md (920 verbatim human turns 2026-05-14 → 2026-08-05, byte-verified against the raw transcripts, with the audit's readings made against the 803 extant on 08-03) as first-hand; raw/desktop_docs_record.md as second-hand; raw/git_record.md as artifact-level and authorship-blind. Mechanical repo description — file paths, how to run a script — is not adjudicated

The four verdict tags: [GROUNDED] traceable to a user quote, cited with date; [AGENT-ORIGIN] no support in the surviving record, an agent wrote it and repetition made it canon; [CONTRADICTS-USER] the record shows the user saying otherwise, both sides cited; [STALE] was true, superseded by a later user decision or by the code. Coverage limit binding on every verdict: nothing survives before 2026-05-14, and 05-16 → 05-26 and 05-29 → 06-26 hold zero records of any kind — a claim with no quote behind it in those windows is marked unsupported in the surviving record, never "the user never said this"

The audit's counts, one verdict per claim, by surface (CLAUDE.md / v3-README / agent defs / laptop memory / DESIGN+CONTRACTS / desktop memory / state docs): GROUNDED 12/5/6/12/7/19/4 = 65; AGENT-ORIGIN 2/2/6/1/2/3/1 = 17; CONTRADICTS-USER 3/2/2/2/0/1/1 = 11; STALE 3/3/0/3/6/7/2 = 24; adjudicated 20/12/14/18/15/30/8 = 117. Two things the raw counts hide: concentration — 5 of the 11 contradictions sit in CLAUDE.md and the agent definitions, the two surfaces every agent loads before doing anything; and compounding — the agent definitions have the worst ratio in the repo (6 grounded vs 6 invented) and are the surface that converts a claim into an enforced hard rule

The charge is substantiated but is narrower and more specific than "agents invented the canon": the behavioural rules are overwhelmingly the user's own words, and the design and results claims are where agents wrote themselves into canon. 65 of 117 — a clear majority — are genuinely the user's, correctly recorded

Ranked item 1 — five of seven "the user's concepts" are agent coinages, and agents are forbidden to change them. [CONTRADICTS-USER] in memory/project_terminology_canon.md and six agent definitions. Measured against all 803 turns: `levels of k's` yes ("well the concepts i were intrested in were the 'fuzzy clustering', 'levels of k's' etc", 07-20); `areas` yes but marginal ("clustering of areas to increase to if hits are weak", 07-15); `walk` no — 18 hits, every one agent text or the user echoing it back; `anchor` no — 5 hits, all inside agent-written text the user pasted; `stated-scope` no — 4 hits, all agent text; `support` no — the technical sense appears only in agent text; `parts` no — the user uses the ordinary word, the field named `parts` is agent. The user's actual complaint was exactly this (07-20): "NONE of these are something i named or invented, what the fuck are they?"

Ranked item 2 — HERB_TAG_FIRST makes tags a gate, 12 minutes after the user forbade it. [CONTRADICTS-USER] at v3/pipelines/artefact_v1.py:167-211, commit 6730d13, branch tag-first-cluster-guide. User 2026-08-01 11:53: "ITS NT SUPPOSED TO BE FUCKING TAG REACHABLE ffs.. tags are supposed to INFORM/weight the chunks"; commit 6730d13 at 2026-08-01 12:05:06 titled "tags-first retrieval regime". He had said the same thing three times before, twice on 07-30. The 08-02 adversarial agent reached his conclusion independently: "HERB_TAG_FIRST is a category error — delete it. Tags weight, they don't select"

Ranked item 3 — "The chunk description is dead" is contradicted by the user on 08-02 and by the shipping code. [CONTRADICTS-USER] + [STALE] in CLAUDE.md and DESIGN.md §9.1/§14.1. User 2026-08-02 09:17: "wasnt the plan to cluster the tags weighted by facets in combination with chunk-descriptions to find the best fit of chunks?"; user 2026-07-06 12:24: "the chunks contain a short description of the chunk … Pretty much all of this is embedded, the chunk description, the tagsnames, the facets". Code at HEAD: the description path is one of three fused rankings with its own weight W_DESC over chunk_desc_emb. The rule is genuinely grounded for the v3 native tagger (06-11) and CLAUDE.md states it unqualified, so every agent applies it to the arm that actually ships — the 07-28 thread's detDESCCORR run made description corroborate-only and recall collapsed to ~0.085

Ranked item 4 — "Never analyze from git archaeology" is contradicted; the user demanded git archaeology, in capitals. [CONTRADICTS-USER] in memory/feedback_grounding.md. User 2026-08-02 22:42: "THE GODDAMN GIT REPO HAS ALL THE FUCKING HISTORY SPOKEN IN COMMITS, DIFFS, CODE and DOCS.. what the actual fuck is wrong with you?"; 21:23: "you do understand that we are currently in a branch we have cleared out of all 'old stuff' also, right? meaning you have to dig in the repo if you want true info". This is the single instruction that kept agents ignorant of their own project: the working tree was deliberately cleared of the design era, so "current repo docs" is precisely the surface that cannot answer a design question

Ranked item 5 — pre-registered pass/fail bars, which the user explicitly rejected. [CONTRADICTS-USER] at maths-algorithmist.md:29 and :15. Agent def: "Compare against the standing bars before proposing. A ranking change is only interesting past scope-alone (0.7926 det 10smoke); a per-query-K mechanism is only interesting past a constant cut at the same mean depth." User 2026-07-31 23:05, shown a bar of exactly this shape: "what is this garbage?"; 23:09: "what the fuck are you even talking about, pass fail?"; 23:10: "we already have the fucking scores to compare to, stop making random shit up". A gate the user rejected in three consecutive turns is written into a permanent specialist's hard rules, where it silently kills proposals before he ever sees them

Ranked items 6 and 7 — which artefact the canon points at. Item 6: CLAUDE.md's "v3/ — the work … The artefact is the system under test, rebuilt natively in v3/artefact/" against 2026-07-26 23:07 "we are NOT doing the v3 artefact, we are doing the v1artefact … EVERYTHING i have been TRYING to build for weeks now, have been the actual v1artefact" — the most-read paragraph in the repo points every fresh agent at the wrong artefact. Item 7: CLAUDE.md's "herb-eval … a contrast/forensic baseline only, not adopted" while DATABASE = os.environ.get("NEO4J_DATABASE", "herb-eval") is where every artefact number the project has ever reported comes from; canon drift is one-sided — at 0efff16 the same rule read "herb-eval is the canonical Neo4j DB", the code never moved and the canon flipped around it

Ranked item 8 — graph refresh as a hard rule at every commit. [AGENT-ORIGIN], and the user pushed back on its cost. CLAUDE.md: "Refresh the navigation graph at commit time … It is the ONLY rebuild path … If it prints a worklist, process it before committing." The user's entire recorded relationship with graphify: "fix graphify then" (07-20); "Use graphify in you can" (07-01); and 07-29 23:02 "ok, but the graphify is only supposed to update actually new things, so that should not take 17 fucking minutes, and changing 2 lines of code.. that took 25 minutes!? no, you are not reporting something here because all of that is actually fully retarded" — immediately after 07-29 23:00 "so, apparently somewhere i the docs there is something telling you to do this?". The user caught this one live; nothing in the record shows him asking for it

Ranked items 9 and 10. Item 9 — "The model emits no numbers, ever" is true canon applied to the wrong system: [STALE]; the rule is the user's own, marked [USER-STATED] at 06-11 with his v1 evidence ("it took so fucking long to get it right and it still didn't work at all"), while the shipping artefact_v1 interpreter's pass-2 prompt is literally "Score retrieval tags against five facets (each 0.0-1.0)" and the validator raises if a facet value is not a number. Item 10 — the "chase the score" framing baked into the memory index, fixed 2026-08-04: the two memory entries are deleted, run numbers live in v3/output/DATA_README.md recomputed from disk and carrying the unmatched-unit rule, and no memory entry holds a run number. What they said stands as the finding, against user 2026-07-25 01:45: "i have fucking nowhere said or hinted that a high … score on something is the fucking target and point of this. the fucking POINT, is that the ARTEFACT, is academically VALID according to WHAT THE FUCK I AM TRYING TO BUILD"

Surface 1 — CLAUDE.md, 20 claims: 12 GROUNDED, 2 AGENT-ORIGIN, 3 CONTRADICTS-USER, 3 STALE. Grounded hard rules: design before build (1.1), plain spoken English short answers (1.2), heed the user's intent (1.3), docs track reality by removal not banners (1.4), no historical or defensive comments on the principle (1.5), every runnable shows life instantly (1.6 — he explicitly asked for this rule to be written down), the graph spine is closed canon (1.12), references never copies (1.13), tags are per-chunk contextual phrases (1.16), the agent roster and orchestrator mode (1.18), long runs in the user's terminal (1.19). Agent-origin: the critical-review gate (1.7) and the graph-refresh rule (1.8). The pattern: the working-relationship rules are almost all genuinely the user's, the machinery rules are the invented ones, and the design statements have drifted off the system that actually ships

Surface 2 — v3/README.md, 12 claims: 5 GROUNDED, 2 AGENT-ORIGIN, 2 CONTRADICTS-USER, 3 STALE. Root README.md is 344 bytes of pointer text, nothing prescriptive, not adjudicated. v3/README carries a `## Decided` heading, which makes every line under it a canon claim. Grounded: RAGAS is the only scorer (06-25, twice, emphatically — which also resolves git_record C-17's alarm that the deleted HERB anchor metric had no rationale, since the rationale is a user ruling git could not see); the haiku judge; the deferred Swedish Bonnier set; the thin fixed generation contract; arms share nothing beyond the generator and the corpus on disk. Contradicts: "artifact … built natively in v3" (2.1), and "Provenance … no seed, no git-sha" (2.5) against his traceability demand. Stale: the top-k budget called open when k=50 has been the operating value since 06-27; the qwen generator; the orchestrator-split note

Surface 3 — the ten .claude/agents/*.md definitions, 14 claims: 6 GROUNDED, 6 AGENT-ORIGIN, 2 CONTRADICTS-USER, 0 STALE — the worst grounded-to-invented ratio in the repo. Grounded: haiku is the settled daily judge (3.6); the judge-run cost math hard rule (3.7, grounded hard by consequence in the 07-17, 07-23 and 07-24 usage burns, with the 06-18 zero-weight instruction as a documented tension); you design judge runs, you do not launch them (3.8); no historical or defensive comments (3.9); propose, never build unaccepted design (3.12); the ten-specialist routing table, which he itemised himself on 07-22 15:45. Agent-origin: the never-re-derive list (3.3), a state doc §8 declared binding (3.4), the DATA_README validity table declared binding in four hard-rule blocks (3.5), the refresh_graph.py instruction conflict (3.10), REFRESH.md-wins precedence (3.11), and mechanisms falsely attributed to the user's judgement (3.14). The rules about how to behave are grounded; the rules about what is settled science are largely agents citing other agents

Surface 4 — laptop memory, 18 claims: 12 GROUNDED, 1 AGENT-ORIGIN, 2 CONTRADICTS-USER, 3 STALE. The behavioural entries are excellent, many near-verbatim and correctly dated: visible progress, background workers, never relaunch expensive runs, judge-run cost math, react to anger, infer context like a human, commit means push, orchestrator mode, reusable tools, source of truth, the final audit panel, the adversarial panel verdicts. feedback_user_concepts_are_canon.md is the best entry in the memory and proves the project could tell the difference — while project_terminology_canon.md (4.1) shows the same memory system failing to, its own provenance line convicting it: every source it names is agent-written. feedback_trust_revoked.md is grounded at origin and stale in its absolutist form. The damage is concentrated in the two project-type entries that describe the design and the results

Surface 5 — v3/artefact/DESIGN.md + MODEL_CONTRACTS.md, 15 claims: 7 GROUNDED, 2 AGENT-ORIGIN, 0 CONTRADICTS-USER, 6 STALE. Note the zero: these documents do not contradict the user, they contradict each other and the shipped code — 13 internal/cross-file conflicts. They are stale, not invented, largely because MODEL_CONTRACTS.md kept the discipline in its opening sentence: "Working draft — approvals happen per-call, in conversation, schemas shown inline (the doc itself is never the approval)", the direct institutional memory of his 06-14 rejection "i never saw the fucking schema". Grounded: the graph indexes references and does not store copies (§1); the closed spine and the node/attribute rule (§7); no hard filters anywhere in ranking, facets always order and never filter (§14.4 — strongly, which makes HERB_TAG_FIRST a violation of design canon as well as of a direct instruction); structural oracle quarantine (§4); no overlap and the deterministic boundary detector (§9.4, §9.5); and §14.9, which explicitly labels an agent invention as such and kills it

Surface 6 — desktop memory (53 files), 30 claims: 19 GROUNDED, 3 AGENT-ORIGIN, 1 CONTRADICTS-USER, 7 STALE. The best-attributed surface in the project: roughly 30 entries carry an explicit user quote in a "Canonical user-established facts" slot, and several files name their own agent inventions and kill them. The June discipline worked. The problems: v3-arm-model-stack.md recording in writing that it overrode source material he handed it (6.1); no-cost-estimates.md's "cost must carry ZERO weight" (6.2), grounded at 06-18 and then destroyed by events, so a fresh agent reading the desktop memory and not the laptop memory would reinstate the behaviour that caused three of the worst incidents; RAGAS-only vs HERB+RAGAS across two files (6.3); herb-eval-arm.md's two flat self-contradictions (6.4); three incompatible settled facet sets (6.5); two embedder ids as settled fact (6.6); "herb-eval never queried live" (6.7); docs-track-reality.md claiming the project uses AGENTS.md (6.8); four model names for two roles (6.9); hub nodes vs the dead hub-node idea, honestly flagged (6.10); the thesis rationale (6.11)

Surface 7 — the state docs, 8 claims: 4 GROUNDED, 1 AGENT-ORIGIN, 1 CONTRADICTS-USER, 2 STALE. USER_CANON.md in its entirety is [GROUNDED] — the one clean surface, spot-checked against the 803-turn corpus with quotes verbatim and correctly dated, opening with an honest provenance table and the warning "Absence of a statement here proves nothing"; its section "THE MISSING PERIOD IS NOT MISSING — IT IS IN GIT. GO READ IT" directly overturns memory entry 4.3. The 2026-07-28 audit-absorption doc is grounded — the revert is his explicit order and the audit was his instruction. The 2026-08-02 benchmark-validity and corpus-facts docs are grounded: recent, measured, caveated. Agent-origin: the 07-22 state doc §8 declared binding, a document he pre-emptively distrusted on the day it was written. Contradicts: state docs recording agent measurements as "the user's verdicts"

User instructions recorded NOWHERE in any canon surface — 17 items a fresh agent loading CLAUDE.md and the memory index would never learn. The structural cause first: USER_CANON.md, the only surface that records the user's words verbatim, is referenced by nothing — not CLAUDE.md's entry-point list, not any agent definition, not the memory index, and the same for the entire docs/canon/ tree; verified by search, zero references. So everything that exists only in USER_CANON.md is in practice still lost, and the file that would fix this audit is itself unreachable. Item 1, gold-blindness, is marked Enforced: a CLAUDE.md hard rule and a hard rule in retrieval-scientist, maths-algorithmist and v3-coder, with runs specified by pointer and read back from eval_results.jsonl, while results-analyst and eval-statistician keep full access because they report and design nothing

What the pattern actually is — three distinct mechanisms produce all the contradictions, and they need different fixes. 1 Laundering by provenance loss: an agent writes a term or a number into a doc, a later agent reads that doc and records it in memory as "the user's", a third enforces it as a hard rule; nothing in the chain is dishonest, each step just drops one bit of attribution, and four steps drop all of it. 2 Canon frozen against a moving system: the design docs describe the v3 native artefact while the thing measured is artefact_v1 over herb-eval, so every "the artefact does X" statement in CLAUDE.md is true of a system that has never been run and false of the one producing every number. 3 Measurements hardening into laws: an agent measures something once, on 10smoke or one configuration, and it becomes a standing bar, a closed decision, a do-not-re-derive line — often after a later audit found the same result not significant. The user identified all three himself on 2026-07-25: "YOU cannot assume canon by the fucking names of things.. you create an item and then suddenly think it's canon just because YOU fucking named it so"
